tools.name: find_city
tools.description: Find a city where kari operates by part of its name. Returns up to 10 cities with city_id.

tools.name: find_stores
tools.description: List kari stores in a city with address, opening hours and coordinates. Filter by part of the name, address, mall or metro station. 10 stores per page.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the kari catalog (shoes, clothing, bags, accessories) with filters. Returns products with price, size range and a link to the website. sizes is the size range of the model, not stock: check stock with get_product or check_availability.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Product details by articul: price, images, color, composition, rating and sizes with availability in the city. Items without sizes have an empty sizes list.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Which kari stores in the city can hand over this size and when (pickup). Up to 10 stores; quantities are not disclosed. Omit size for items without sizes.
